projects.name: floe
projects.tagline: Streaming lakehouse on Kubernetes, up with one command
projects.pitch: Live Wikipedia edits flow through Redpanda, are validated against a data contract and land exactly once in Apache Iceberg on S3-compatible storage. dbt builds silver and gold behind a data-quality gate, and FastAPI serves the result. KEDA scales the processor on consumer lag, Prometheus and Grafana watch it, and CI deploys it all into kind.
highlights: Exactly-once without trusting Kafka offsets: each batch's rows and Kafka offsets go into one Iceberg commit, with fencing against zombie replicas, so a SIGKILLed pod loses or duplicates nothing
Helm chart with generated secrets, non-root read-only containers, NetworkPolicies, KEDA on lag, CronJob transforms and compaction; Trivy gates the image and chart in CI
The dbt quality gate (17 tests) publishes gold only on a full pass, and it caught real duplicate events from overlapping producers during a rolling restart

projects.name: aiwatch
projects.tagline: Find, fix and continuously monitor AI-stack vulnerabilities
projects.pitch: Inventories an AI/LLM repo (ML dependencies, MCP servers, Hugging Face refs, model artifacts and risky loading code), matches it against live OSV.dev advisories and writes the fixes. A daily GitHub Action then reports what is new since yesterday, and why.
highlights: Minimal safe version bumps, co-resolved with uv so the fixed set installs together, plus HF commit-SHA pins, weights_only=True, yaml.safe_load and pinned MCP servers
SQLite baseline separates newly disclosed advisories from known ones and from drift (new risky code, config or dependencies)
Ranks by real-world exploitation (CISA KEV + FIRST EPSS) before CVSS; SARIF to code scanning, one tracking issue, HTML dashboard; OWASP LLM Top 10 2025 and MITRE ATLAS mappings

stats.label: CVSS-queue rank of the one KEV-listed bug

projects.name: loadsafe
projects.tagline: Find, fix and monitor ML model supply-chain risk
projects.pitch: Audits pickle, PyTorch, joblib, NumPy, safetensors, ONNX, GGUF and Keras artifacts, plus the Hugging Face repos that ship them, before anything gets loaded. It then converts unsafe checkpoints to safetensors and watches pinned repos for drift.
highlights: Symbolic pickle machine resolves STACK_GLOBAL / memo tricks and attributes every REDUCE to a callable
loadsafe fix: scan-first gate + data-only unpickler converts PyTorch checkpoints to safetensors, bit-identical to torch.load(weights_only=True)
ML-BOM diff flags format downgrades and new findings; a weekly monitor re-checks pinned HF repos. SARIF + CycloneDX, OWASP LLM03/04, MITRE ATLAS

projects.name: mcp-warden
projects.tagline: Scan, harden and guard MCP servers
projects.pitch: Scans an MCP server's tools before you connect it, writes a least-privilege policy, then sits between any agent and the server to enforce it. A daily monitor re-scans the latest official servers for rug pulls.
highlights: scan / harden: poisoning, shadowing, code-exec and egress tools, lethal trifecta → default-deny policy + SHA-256 lockfile
Runtime gateway: argument rules, PII / secret redaction, injection scanning, approvals bound to the exact call
SARIF mapped to OWASP LLM / Agentic Top 10 and MITRE ATLAS; hash-chained audit log; red-team, held-out and real-server evals

projects.name: promptstrike
projects.tagline: Find → fix → verify red-teaming for LLM apps
projects.pitch: Attacks an LLM app config on a local model with 103 OWASP- and ATLAS-mapped attacks, writes the hardening for what actually failed, and proves each layer with held-out attacks, a utility suite and paired stats. The same scan gates CI and re-runs weekly.
highlights: Remediation planner: secrets out of prompt, least-privilege tools, instruction-hierarchy prompt chosen on dev data only, spotlighting, deterministic input/output guards, tool-approval gate
Cumulative ablation with Wilson CIs, exact McNemar, dev/held-out splits for attacks and benign tasks, so over-refusal shows up
Gate, drift diff and SARIF to code scanning; composite GitHub Action and weekly real-model monitor. No API keys

projects.name: hopscope
projects.tagline: GraphRAG vs vector RAG, measured on multi-hop QA
projects.pitch: A key-free benchmark harness built around one question: when does knowledge-graph retrieval actually beat vector RAG on multi-hop questions, and what does it cost?
highlights: HippoRAG-style entity graph with Personalized PageRank, built without an LLM
Complete-evidence-chain metrics, answer attribution, disjoint dev/test tuning
Paired bootstrap confidence intervals; routing by query type matters
